facts.label: Chalo Yaar in numbers
facts.fuels: fuels tracked: petrol, diesel and CNG
facts.labels: status labels, each with a report time
facts.languages: languages, and every screen can be read aloud

landing.legendTitle: Unknown means nobody has confirmed it yet.
landing.legendBody: Every fuel status uses one of 5 labels: an icon, a word and the report time. Colour is never the only clue.

legend.available: A recent report says this fuel is in stock.
legend.queue: Fuel is there, but a driver reported a line.
legend.stale: The last report has expired. Check before you drive over.
legend.unavailable: A recent report says this fuel has run out.
legend.unknown: No one has reported this fuel yet. We show Unknown instead of guessing, and we never treat missing data as empty.

landing.actionsTitle: 4 buttons on the home screen. That is the whole app.
landing.actionsBody: Big targets, plain words and a speaker on every screen, built for a phone in one hand.

actions.fuel: Nearby stations for petrol, diesel or CNG, with status, distance and directions.
actions.help: Puncture, battery or towing, sent only to approved providers in your area.
actions.savings: Compare the real cost of a fill-up, including the extra fuel to drive there.
actions.car: Log each refuel to track mileage and monthly fuel spend.

landing.voiceTitle: Every screen can be read aloud, in 4 languages.
landing.voiceBody: Tap the speaker on any card. Change language whenever you like; your choice stays saved on this phone.

routeComparison.title: Route & TrueCost
routeComparison.subtitle: Compare fuel stops along your road route. Estimates depend on recorded prices and your assumptions.
routeComparison.locationDenied: Location was not shared. Select a starting area instead.
routeComparison.destinationHint: Pilot destinations: City Centre, Susan Road and D Ground. For another destination, enter its coordinates; general address search is not connected.
routeComparison.economyHint: Saved vehicle economy takes precedence. Without economy, only a valid fuel purchase estimate can be shown. CNG units are not supported.
routeComparison.privacy: Coordinates are used for this comparison and sent to the configured routing service, not saved to your account. Maps and external directions also share their viewed area with those services.
routeComparison.loadError: Comparison could not be loaded. Please retry.
routeComparison.vehicleError: Vehicles could not be loaded. You can still enter your own economy.
routeComparison.routeUnavailable: Road route comparison is unavailable. No detour distance or route total has been calculated. Routing must return a road route and its geometry within the 150 km pilot limit.
routeComparison.nearbyFallback: Find nearby stations without route comparison
routeComparison.coverage: Up to six recorded-fuel stations within 2 km of the road route are checked. This is not exhaustive coverage or a stock confirmation.
routeComparison.rankedTotal: Sorted by estimated total. Each option has a valid price and road detour.
routeComparison.rankedDistance: Sorted by added road distance, not claimed savings. Unroutable stations appear last.
routeComparison.noStations: No eligible stations with recorded fuel metadata were found near this route. Missing fuel details do not prove a shortage.
routeComparison.referencePrice: Reviewed reference price, not a confirmed pump price
routeComparison.missingPrice: No valid reviewed price is available. Purchase cost and monetary total are unknown.
routeComparison.viaUnavailable: Via-station road route unavailable. No added distance or detour fuel cost has been calculated.
routeComparison.priceExpired: A price used in the comparison has expired. Compare again before relying on a monetary estimate.
routeComparison.disclaimer: Estimates only, not guaranteed savings, live fuel stock, safe routes or arrival times. No verified redeemable offers are connected; discount is zero.
routeComparison.personalHint: Your figures only, separate from station results. This does not calculate a road detour or use a verified station price. No discount is applied.
routeComparison.priceChecked: I checked the source, amount and validity dates.

reasons.near_route: Included because recorded fuel metadata and location match the route corridor.
reasons.reference_price: Price is a reference price, not confirmed at this pump.
reasons.station_price: Price is a reviewed, dated station-specific figure.
reasons.missing_price: No valid reviewed price; no monetary total.
reasons.via_route_unavailable: Via route failed or was inconsistent with the direct route.
reasons.missing_economy: Economy is missing; detour fuel cost cannot be calculated.
reasons.verified_offer: A verified eligible offer was applied.
reasons.no_verified_offer: No verified eligible offer; discount is zero.
reasons.unverified_details: Station details have not been human-verified.
reasons.ranked_total: Ranked by estimated total, not a promise of savings.
reasons.ranked_distance: Less added road distance ranks first where price/economy is incomplete.

discovery.areaHint: Pilot areas: City Centre, Susan Road and D Ground. Other areas are not supported yet.
discovery.locationPrivacy: Location is optional. Search coordinates are used for this lookup, not saved to your account. Opening the map shares the viewed area with the map service.
discovery.petrolReports: Showing petrol reports. Select a fuel to see its reports.
discovery.radius: Within {radius} km; up to 50 nearest results.
discovery.noFuelMetadata: This filter requires human-verified fuel types and a verification date. Unknown details do not mean fuel is unavailable. Try All to see unverified leads.
discovery.noVerifiedTitle: No verified stations in these results
discovery.noVerifiedMessage: Station names, pins and fuel types still need a dated human check. Any records below are unverified leads, not confirmed fuel stops. This is a data gap, not evidence of a shortage.
discovery.notGuaranteed: Reports are time-limited, not a guarantee of fuel on arrival.
discovery.checked: I checked the pin, fuel types and station details.
